claude.rationale: The deal contributed an entire wholly-owned Parker subsidiary into the JV, so product and process moved together: the fuel-nozzle product (T4) was contributed "together with its product" in the existing Clyde, New York producing facility (T5), giving gap_45=0. The ~300-person workforce of "skilled assemblers, technicians, engineers" was contributed alongside the facility "Continuing its long history in the Clyde community," so processes and the organization/people running them (T6) moved together, giving gap_56=0. T1 is imprint-share and T3 is swap because a 50-50 JV in a new LLC vehicle places two non-related parents' intents jointly into a newly formed legal entity.

grok.rationale: gap_45 is 0 because the slice states the producing operation was contributed together with its product: the JV is located in the existing Parker Gas Turbine Fuel Systems Division facility in Clyde, New York, and was created to produce the fuel-nozzle product line. gap_56 is 0 because the people who run the operation were contributed alongside the facility and product: the JV employs approximately 300 skilled assemblers, technicians, engineers, and other professionals continuing at Clyde. No product-vs-process or process-vs-organization structural mismatch is documented at closing.
